facts.business: Global Health Limited (Medanta) operates a network of six multi-specialty tertiary and quaternary care hospitals across Gurugram, Lucknow, Patna, Noida, Ranchi, and Indore, delivering comprehensive healthcare across 30+ specialties supported by diagnostics, pharmacies, clinics, and homecare services.
